alina: Heads-up on PR #1337 — example for POST /v1/generate nested the `usage` object under `meta` in the response example (`meta: { usage: { prompt_tokens: 12 } }`) but our OpenAPI schema has `usage` at the top level. This breaks example validation. cc @petra @mike

petra: Link?

alina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1337 — backend tolerates both shapes right now, but we should keep the canonical example matching the schema.

mike: openapi-lint will flag that. Also codegen/sdks will generate different models depending on canonical shape. We should avoid drifting examples.

docs-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /paths/~1v1~1generate/post/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema expected property `usage` at root but found in example under `meta`.

petra: Proposed fix: revert example to put `usage` at top level. Add a short "Backward compatibility" note showing the legacy nested shape and a tiny parsing example for Python and Rust. That way users know to handle both.

alina: Agreed. For Python snippet: `usage = resp.get('usage') or resp.get('meta', {}).get('usage')` and add a comment about types. For Rust, show defensive extraction using serde_json: `let usage = obj.get("usage").or_else(|| obj.get("meta").and_then(|m| m.get("usage")));` Keep it minimal.

mike: Add a test fixture in examples/fixtures/generate-resp-both.json with both variants and add examples-validate to fail CI if canonical example doesn't match schema. Also add one line in the docs changelog: "Docs: normalize generate response usage shape and add migration snippets (Python, Rust)."

alina: I'll update the PR: revert canonical example, append the compatibility note + code snippets, add fixture, and wire examples-validate in CI. Pushing a small commit now.

docs-bot: ci/checks: openapi-lint failed until example matches schema.

alina: Pushed fix. Reverted example, added note/snippets, included fixture. Triggering CI. Ping @petra @mike for review.

petra: Quick nit: Rust snippet should show `if let Some(usage) = usage_val` guard and recommend mapping token counts to usize. Add that tiny hint.

mike: LGTM after that tweak.

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

petra: Approved. Merge when green.

alina: Merged. Closing thread. :tada:
